title: World building

body.text: Make a fantasy/sci-fi world feel real by having the AI help
trace the chain of consequences of the rules you set
— e.g. 'if magic costs years of your lifespan, what would this world's economy, religion, and laws look like?'

example: "A world where it rains only once a year: help me think through the effects on architecture, occupations, festivals, and political conflict"

title: A world bible keeps the world from breaking

body.text: Keep the world's rules in a
world bible and have the AI run a consistency check
— as the story grows, it helps catch things like 'chapter 12 violates the magic rule set in chapter 2'.

example: "Here's the world bible and a draft of a new chapter — check whether anything conflicts with the world's rules"

question: How does the AI help world building best?

options.text: Tracing the chain of consequences of the rules you set
Copying the world from a famous movie
Just generating city names at random
A document collecting the story world's rules and information

question: What does a consistency check help with?

options.text: Catching where the story conflicts with the world's set rules

question: What should world building have to keep the world from contradicting itself?

options.text: Just remember it all in your head
A world bible collecting the world's rules and details

question: How do you use Claude to help with world building?

options.text: Help expand details and check consistency
Build the whole world for us without checking
